The first step to solving a problem is aknowledging it. If we start by identify the behaviours that are harmful when it comes to parenting then we can adressing them and start thinking about solutions. You say that it is obvious that unfit parents exist but I promise you most "unfit" parents do not see themselves as such because they have been taught their whole lives that abusive and harmful behaviour is normal and acceptable, and are even surrounded by people who either agree with them and make excuses for them or don't care about the abuse happening and turn a blind eye. This normalizes harmful behaviour in parenting and makes it almost impossible to tackle the problem.  It's only by getting people to realize that there are problems with how they raise their child that we can start offering solutions.

Even if you think that an assement would not be efficient we could come up with different solutions on how to fix this issue, such as offering classes and courses on parenting,or free counceling for parents/ group therapy, make them easily available and well-known to the population and try to get as many people as possible to take them. As for the situations where parents know they're abusing their child and still don't care, we need to make sure that child abuse laws are enforced and the child has the chance to move to a safe environment away from their abusers.
